ammonia.reason: Negligible amino acid deamination and proteolysis in days-old fused cheese.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized milk with no Brevibacterium, p-cresol or indole maturation.

bitter.reason: No aged hydrophobic peptides; slight bitterness only from emulsifying salts.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti and no blue maturation.

browning.reason: Lactose plus milk protein Maillard on 85-90C fusion but high moisture limits color.

buttery.reason: High milkfat from added cream/butter oil retaining diacetyl and delta-lactones.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Minimal lipolysis so only trace butyric/hexanoic/octanoic acids by HS-SPME.

creaminess.reason: Homogenized fat-in-caseinate emulsion with phosphate/citrate melting salts.

crumbliness.reason: Fused emulsified network spreads rather than fracturing.

firmness.reason: High moisture ~62% and calcium-chelated protein gives spreadable soft body.

fruity.reason: Trace methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone but minimal ester synthesis when fresh.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: No aged Strecker aldehydes or propionibacteria from fresh short storage.

melt.reason: Emulsifying salts chelate calcium restoring casein flow on reheating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Only trace 1-octanol, no 1-octen-3-ol mold linoleate oxidation.

oil_off.reason: Stable 22% fat emulsion but free butter oil can leak on overheating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol formation.

sour_vinegar.reason: Direct lactic acid acidification to pH 5.2-5.8 with little acetic fermentation.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata alignment; short calcium-chelated caseinate network.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Milk heated to 80C plus 85-90C fusion denatures whey protein releasing sulfhydryls.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and cream perception balanced by lactic acidity.

umami.reason: Soluble glutamate from casein/caseinate but no aged proteolysis to intensify.
